correctness.rationale: For nonnegative graph-ball matrices, the nonlinear \(\ell^2\) norm equals the maximum of selector Gram top eigenvalues. The standalone exact-integer script enumerates every one of 20,480 masks, proves Sylvester strict separators for all 20,461 nonwinning masks, certifies strict Rayleigh lower bounds and isolating upper bounds for winners, and computes complete integer characteristic polynomials. The winning Gram matrices are strictly positive, giving Perron-unique moduli; dihedral conjugacy yields all equality cases with arbitrary phases. The scope is exactly two finite cycles.
